definitions.explanation: A reference back to something that has already been written or described earlier in the same document or discussion.

examples.japanese: {既述|きじゅつ}のとおりである。
{既述|きじゅつ}の{理由|りゆう}により{却下|きゃっか}する。
examples.english: It is rejected for the reasons already stated.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}については{既述|きじゅつ}の{章|しょう}で{詳|くわ}しく{論|ろん}じたので、ここでは{省略|しょうりゃく}する。
examples.english: Since this issue was discussed in detail in the previous chapter, it will be omitted here.

notes:
A compound of {既|き} (already) and {述|じゅつ} (to state, to describe). A formal written-language word used to refer back to earlier content in reports, papers, and official documents. Rarely used in spoken Japanese.

USAGE:
Almost exclusively a written-language word. Commonly appears as {既述|きじゅつ}の (the aforementioned) or {既述|きじゅつ}のとおり (as previously stated).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既述|きじゅつ}のとおり — as previously stated
- {既述|きじゅつ}の{内容|ないよう} — the previously described content
- {既述|きじゅつ}の{理由|りゆう} — the reasons already stated

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前述|ぜんじゅつ} — aforementioned; very similar in meaning but {前述|ぜんじゅつ} emphasizes sequence (what came before), while {既述|きじゅつ} emphasizes that it has already been done
- {記述|きじゅつ} — description, statement; a homophone with a different meaning — the act of writing or describing, rather than a reference to prior content
